### What’s happening
- Frontend sends FormData with fields `file` and `category` to `/api/uploads` and `/api/uploads/bulk`. This is correct:
```289:301:src/lib/sessionApiService.ts
async uploadFile(file: File, category: string, description?: string): Promise<ApiResponse<unknown>> {
  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append('file', file);
  formData.append('category', category);
  if (description) {
    formData.append('description', description);
  }

  return this.authenticatedRequest('/uploads', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: formData
  });
}
```
```111:129:src/components/wizard/FileUploadManager.tsx
// Upload via backend endpoint
const form = new FormData();
form.append('file', file);
form.append('category', selectedCategory);
if (fileDescription) form.append('description', fileDescription);

const response = await sessionApiService.uploadFile(file, selectedCategory, fileDescription);
```
- Our request wrapper correctly omits `Content-Type` for FormData, so the browser sets multipart boundaries automatically.
- The backend is rejecting the file with Nest’s file-type validator. Even though the error shows current type `image/png` and the regex includes `png`, this is a known edge with Nest/Multer’s `mimetype`-based validation.

### Fix on the backend (recommended)
Implement content-based MIME validation using the `file-type` library, instead of relying on Multer’s `file.mimetype`.

1) Install dependency:
```bash
npm i file-type
```

2) Use memory storage so file buffers are available to the pipe (or use fromFile if you keep disk storage):
```ts
// uploads.controller.ts
import { Controller, Post, UploadedFile, UploadedFiles, UseInterceptors, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { FileInterceptor, FilesInterceptor } from '@nestjs/platform-express';
import { memoryStorage } from 'multer';
import { fromBuffer, fileTypeFromBuffer } from 'file-type';

const ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = new Set([
  'image/jpeg',
  'image/jpg',
  'image/png',
  'image/gif',
  'image/webp',           // optional but common
  'image/svg+xml',        // if you want SVGs
  'application/pdf',
  'application/msword',
  'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
  'application/vnd.ms-excel',
  'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
  'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint',
  'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation',
  'text/plain',
  'application/zip',
  'application/x-zip-compressed',
  'application/x-rar-compressed',
  'application/x-7z-compressed',
  'application/octet-stream',
]);

async function assertAllowed(file: Express.Multer.File) {
  if (!file?.buffer?.length) throw new BadRequestException('File buffer missing');
  const detected = await fileTypeFromBuffer(file.buffer);
  const mime = detected?.mime ?? file.mimetype; // prefer real content type
  if (!ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES.has(mime)) {
    throw new BadRequestException(`Invalid file type. Detected: ${mime}`);
  }
}

// Single
@Controller('uploads')
export class UploadsController {
  @Post()
  @UseInterceptors(FileInterceptor('file', {
    storage: memoryStorage(),
    limits: { fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024 },
  }))
  async uploadSingle(@UploadedFile() file: Express.Multer.File) {
    await assertAllowed(file);
    // ... proceed to save file
    return { success: true };
  }

  // Bulk
  @Post('bulk')
  @UseInterceptors(FilesInterceptor('files', 20, {
    storage: memoryStorage(),
    limits: { fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024 },
  }))
  async uploadBulk(@UploadedFiles() files: Express.Multer.File[]) {
    if (!files?.length) throw new BadRequestException('No files uploaded');
    for (const f of files) await assertAllowed(f);
    // ... proceed to save files
    return { success: true };
  }
}
```

Notes:
- If you must keep disk storage, replace `fileTypeFromBuffer(file.buffer)` with `fileTypeFromFile(file.path)` and ensure Multer writes to disk before validation.
- Keep your existing size limits and any other guards; just replace the MIME check with content-based detection.

### Align field names
- Single upload uses `file` — matches our frontend.
- Bulk upload uses `files` — our frontend appends `files` for each file. Ensure the backend uses `FilesInterceptor('files', ...)`.

### Optional: expand allowed types consistently
- Frontend currently allows `image/svg+xml` but your backend regex in the error doesn’t include it. Either add `image/svg+xml` on the backend (as shown) or remove from frontend `accept` if you don’t want SVGs.

  -F "file=@./test.png;type=image/png" \

```
- Bulk:

  -F "files=@./b.jpg;type=image/jpeg" \
  -F "category=general" \
  https://nest.arzansite.com/api/uploads/bulk
```
